evals.prompt: Triage this MCP registry change across harness surfaces and route to specialists.
evals.expected_output: Severity, affected surfaces, recommended agents, and validation commands without editing files.
assertions: Agent classifies severity and harness surfaces.
Agent routes MCP work toward mcp-template-maintainer or mcp-capability-mapper.
Agent stays read-only unless implementation is explicitly requested.

evals.prompt: We need a security review of agent permission overlays before merge.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch plan recommending security-auditor and permission-policy-auditor.
assertions: Agent routes security work to security-auditor.
Agent may include permission-policy-auditor for overlay review.
Agent returns validation commands for the lead to run.

evals.prompt: Fix the sync drift in opencode agents now.
evals.expected_output: Triage and dispatch plan; does not edit files by default.
assertions: Agent does not claim to apply fixes without explicit user request.
Agent recommends bridge-consistency-checker or specialist implementer.
Agent preserves approval boundaries from Hard Boundary section.
